name: continuity_progress_cancel
title: Continuity：查询进度，重连后取消同一任务
description: Two real-provider rounds through the production session/router with the in-memory fixture executor (no desktop side effects): a progress question, then a cancel after reconnect. The runner requires the same task identity to survive the reconnect, a fresh turn binding for the cancel, zero repeated desktop actions, and an honest final status.
user_words: 这个任务进行到哪一步了？ → 取消这个任务
utterances: 这个任务进行到哪一步了？

progress_language.required_semantics_note: Work order 02 requires progress speech to distinguish delivery from verification; the verbatim text is always recorded. Set --require-evidence-language to gate on it.

her_receipt_source_fields: report.rounds[*].status (the product report spells it receipt_status)
report.published_receipts[*].current_action_facts (delivery, outcome_evidence, completion_policy, completion_basis, attempt_id, label, satisfied), matched to a round by the receipt's own turn_id
model_tool_arguments_source_fields: report.calls[*] (the verbatim provider tool calls, exactly what the click scenarios record)

report.rounds[*].tool_name + report.rounds[*].tool_arguments (the continuity probe's verbatim record of the model's task_control call — the report-level equivalent of the realtime session's pendingCall)
evidence_layers.model_tool_arguments_verbatim_optional_r: A continuity turn's only provider tool call is a task_control progress/cancel query: it carries the action and the task identity, not the click-step action arguments (target_label/region/steps) the click scenarios judge. When the probe report records the call but not its verbatim arguments JSON — a runner-level dry-run mock chain — the layer keeps the recorded control facts with arguments=null and names the absent field, and no arguments string is invented to fill the hole.
